# EasyNaukri - Auto Job Application & Cold Outreach Email Platform

EasyNaukri is an AI-powered auto job application and cold outreach email platform. It optimizes resumes for ATS screening, automates recruiter email outreach via Gmail API, and tracks application pipelines.

## Primary Public SEO Landing Pages & Services

- [Auto Job Application Bot](https://easynaukri.online/auto-job-application): AI-driven automatic job application bot. Matches candidate profile skills, auto-fills application forms, and optimizes resumes for high ATS match scores.
- [Cold Outreach Email for Jobs](https://easynaukri.online/cold-outreach-email): Recruiter email automation tool. Dispatches personalized cover letters and outreach emails straight to hiring managers via authorized Gmail OAuth (gmail.send).
- [Sarkari Naukri Alerts & Govt Jobs](https://easynaukri.online/sarkari-naukri-alerts): Real-time government job alerts (UPSC, SSC, RRB, IBPS), category age eligibility calculator (OBC/SC/ST/PwBD), PYQ question banks, and official exam syllabus explorer.
- [Official Chrome Extension](https://easynaukri.online/extension): Browser extension for instant job scraping and one-click application autofill.
- [About EasyNaukri](https://easynaukri.online/about): Platform vision, mission, and company details.
- [Privacy Policy](https://easynaukri.online/privacy): Strict user data protection guidelines and Google OAuth API Services compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://easynaukri.online/terms): Terms of service and usage conditions.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Graph)

Q: What is EasyNaukri?
A: EasyNaukri is an AI automation platform that automates job applications across major portals, sends personalized cold outreach emails to recruiters via Gmail, and provides real-time Sarkari Naukri alerts with age eligibility tools.

Q: How many daily applications does EasyNaukri support?
A: EasyNaukri supports up to 50 automated submissions per day with a 15-day Free Elite Trial.

Q: How does EasyNaukri handle Gmail OAuth security?
A: EasyNaukri uses send-only Google OAuth permissions (gmail.send) to dispatch user-approved outreach emails. It never reads, scans, or deletes non-outreach inbox emails.
